description: This PHP class "InvalidRegexPatternRule" implements PHPStan's Rule interface to detect invalid regex patterns in static method calls such as preg and regex functions. It analyzes PHP code nodes, extracts pattern strings, and validates their correctness.

classes.name: InvalidRegexPatternRule
classes.description: A PHPStan Rule implementation that validates regex patterns used in static calls within PHP code, providing static analysis feedback for invalid regex patterns.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Returns the type of PHP parser node this rule applies to, which is StaticCall.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a given PHP parser node to extract patterns and check for invalid regex patterns, returning any errors found.

methods.name: extractPatterns
methods.description: Internal method that analyzes a static call node to extract regex pattern strings based on the function and class being called.

methods.name: validatePattern
methods.description: Validates a given regex pattern string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.
